observations: Photo 0 and 1 show an industrial flatbed single-needle sewing machine mounted on a metal stand with a white table.
The machine head is labeled 'EmEL' with a red oval logo, visible in both photos.
A model number appears printed on the arm but is too small/blurred to read with confidence.
A measuring tape, scissors, bobbin, and a small red accessory box sit on the table.
Under the table is an installed motor control box (ON/OFF switch, green/red indicator) and a separate boxed item labeled 'EMEL CLUTCH MOTOR EM350A-H'.
Floor and surroundings suggest a home/workshop tailoring setup, not a factory floor.
No manual, power cable to wall, or machine running is visible in either photo.

Brand name 'EmEL' visible in photo 0 and 1 is a known Chinese-manufactured industrial sewing machine brand, not Japanese; no Japanese markings or nameplate origin visible.
